Agent Name: Tizin_Translation_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: This step is the first point where the reasoning path becomes irrecoverable because the agent incorrectly identifies the subject pronoun "I" as "Pa" (nominative) instead of "Mato" (accusative). Since the Tizin verb "Maktay" means "is pleasing to," the person liking the apples is the object of the sentence and must take the accusative case; failing to apply this rule here prevents the construction of a grammatically correct sentence in all subsequent steps.
